Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- "DAIMA" or "Dragon Ball Seekers" Category allies' Ki +2 and
ATK & DEF 40%{passiveImg:up_g}
- High chance of evading enemy's attack
*When there is a "DAIMA" or "Dragon Ball Seekers" Category enemy*
- ATK 150%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional Super Attack
*When the character is the 1st attacker at the start of turn*
- Changes Ki Spheres: AGL to STR
*When the character is the 2nd attacker at the start of turn*
- Changes Ki Spheres: AGL to TEQ
*When the character is the 3rd attacker at the start of turn*
- Changes Ki Spheres: AGL to PHY
*When there are 3 "DAIMA" Category allies or
3 "Dragon Ball Seekers" Category allies attacking in the same turn*
- Changes Ki Spheres: INT to Rainbow
- ATK 350%{passiveImg:up_g} and DEF 150%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Attacks are effective against all Types
- Launches an additional attack that has a great chance of becoming
a Super Attack
*Before attacking*
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 35%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When receiving an attack from an enemy who is hit by the character's
Super Attack*
- DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Damage reduction rate 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
